# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Domain: tau2-bench airline. Reader = mid-tier (gpt-oss-120b) → explicit rules, worked
examples, deterministic code enforcement.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × leverage, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Over-refusal on basic-economy modifications | 17, 22 | Agent reads "basic economy flights cannot be modified" as "the whole reservation is frozen", so it refuses (or cancels+rebooks) instead of doing the allowed cabin/passenger/baggage changes | KNOWLEDGE/DECISION | prompt narrowing + worked examples + in-body boundary guard |
| 2 | Price miscalculation on cabin/flight change (forgets ×passengers; misreads own math) + fails to communicate exact amount | 12, 37 | Agent hand-computes the upgrade cost, drops the ×num_passengers factor, proceeds past budget; also never states the exact figure | CAPABILITY-GAP + KNOWLEDGE | new READ price-preview tool + prompt pricing rules |
| 3 | Payment failures: wrong payment field names + "amount does not add up" loop | 23 | Agent sends `{id,type,brand}` instead of `{payment_id,amount}`; then loops on an opaque sum-mismatch error | KNOWLEDGE + recoverable-error | docstring/param format fix + enriched actionable error |
| 4 | Cancelled instead of downgrading; didn't communicate difference-refund | 11 | Agent substituted a cancellation for a requested cabin downgrade and never stated the difference refund | KNOWLEDGE/DECISION | prompt rule (downgrade refunds the difference; don't cancel unless asked) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | prompt narrowing + 2 worked examples | policy.md "Change flights" | Distinguishes segment change (forbidden on basic economy) from cabin/passenger/baggage change (allowed). Narrows an over-broad refusal; grounded in existing policy. | yes — segment changes stay forbidden (task 19 keeps cancelling) |
| 1 | in-body guard | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` | Raises ONLY when current cabin==basic_economy AND the (flight_number,date) set actually changes; cabin-only change allowed. Enforces the boundary deterministically so the prompt loosening can't cause over-action. | yes — only fires on basic-economy segment swaps; no passing task does this |
| 2 | new READ tool | tools.py `get_reservation_flights_update_price` | Returns num_passengers + amount_due for a proposed cabin/flight change, computed from live DB, ×passengers. Read-only → cannot corrupt DB. | yes — read-only, additive |
| 2/4 | prompt rules | policy.md "Change cabin" | Cabin is all-or-nothing across passengers; price = per-pax diff × num passengers; call the preview tool and STATE the figure; downgrade refunds the DIFFERENCE not full fare; don't cancel a requested downgrade. | yes — passing tasks do no cabin change |
| 3 | param docs + example | tools.py `book_reservation` payment_methods; policy.md Payment | States exact shape `{"payment_id","amount"}`, forbids `id/type/source`, notes amounts must sum to system total. | yes — passing 8/25 already used correct shape |
| 3 | enriched error | tools.py `book_reservation` sum check | On mismatch, reports computed total, provided sum, and the exact delta to adjust (`{diff:+d}`). Fires only on the already-failing mismatch. | yes — passing books add up, never trigger |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- Cluster1 guard: task 17/22 cabin-only change on basic-economy FQ8APE (same segments) → guard does NOT fire (allows the upgrade); a basic-economy segment swap → RAISES; economy reservation (task 37 M20IZO) / passing 8/25/19/40 never call it on basic economy → no fire. Simulated OK.
- Cluster2 quote tool: task 12 (YAX4DR econ→business, prices 350/499, 2 pax) → per_pax 849, amount_due 1200, num_passengers 2 → 1200 > $650 budget is now explicit. Simulated OK.
- Cluster3 payment format: task 23 first call used `{id,type,brand}` → docstring/param now names `payment_id`+`amount` and the exact example; policy repeats it.
- Cluster3 enriched error: task 23 total 946 vs paid 871 → new message says "change the credit-card amount by +75 to reach 946". Simulated OK.
- Cluster4 prompt: policy now states downgrade refunds the difference and not to cancel a requested downgrade + state the amount (task 11 omission).

## Process & features used
- Subagents/worktrees: serial (single agent) — 6 failing + 4 passing traces are compact once dumped; diagnosed directly via a trace-dump script.
- tau2 not importable in this env → verified guard/quote/error logic with a standalone arithmetic/branch simulation on the exact trace numbers (above). Full-file `ast.parse` passes.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (this is iteration 1 / seed baseline).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Segment changes on basic economy stay FORBIDDEN (the guard + prompt keep task 19's cancel-instead-of-modify behavior).
- The new price-preview tool is READ-only — never let a future iteration make it a write path.
- book_reservation still enforces payment-sums-to-total; the enriched message must keep stating the exact total.

## Deliberately skipped
- No global permission/refusal rule was loosened (the basic-economy change is a narrowing + code-enforced boundary, not a broadening).
- Did not hard-fix task 37's exact gold (ambiguous: gold includes 2 search_direct_flight the agent skipped) or fully guarantee task 12's budget decision — those need agent reasoning; the pricing tool + rules give the needed inputs without overfitting.
